description: This Python source file implements API endpoints for user and profile management in an appointment booking system using FastAPI. It includes routes to get and update the current user's info and profile, fetch user types, retrieve any user's profile by ID, and delete (deactivate) the current user account.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to organize related endpoints.

methods.name: get_my_user_info(current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches the information of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: get_my_profile( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Returns the full profile (patient or doctor) of the authenticated user.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: dict, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows the authenticated user to update their profile data, depending on their user type.

methods.name: get_user_type( user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db) )
methods.description: Determines whether a user ID belongs to a patient or a doctor.

methods.name: get_profile_by_user_id( user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches a user's profile (patient or doctor) given their user ID.

methods.name: delete_my_account( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Marks the current user's account as inactive, effectively deleting it.
